Patch Set 1:

(2 comments)

Experimental feature testing in progress, please pay attention to the comments

Mostly good, a couple of comments inline. The premise checks out: nothing under lustre/utils/, lnet/utils/ or lustre/tests/ issues this ioctl, and OBD_IOC_GETDEVICE already reports each device's UUID, so userspace can resolve a UUID from `lctl dl` output. The main question is whether the interface should go through the tree's existing deprecation path first rather than being deleted in one step.

commit.subject: LU-20491 obdclass: remove uuid2dev() interface
commit.message:
LU-20491 obdclass: remove uuid2dev() interface

No Lustre tool calls the uuid2dev ioctl(). No userspace
program ought to call this ioctl(), since they could just
as easily parse the global device list. Remove this interface.

Test-Parameters: trivial
Signed-off-by: Timothy Day <timday@thelustrecollective.com>
